summary: Spec review of the Phase 10 amendment at HEAD 890016dd. The amendment serves the PM request of 2026-11-07: one picture for each of the 51 family words of w01 to w07 (6, 10, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7; w08 none), then one revision folder per week to the PM by 2026-11-12, before Daniel's 11-16 check. The facts hold: the shipped weeks hold 51 family image objects with prompt, characters, and caption and no file, w08 holds 18 words and no image object, the 15 card sources exist as 1500 x 1500 RGB PNG files named l2-w<NN>-card-<word>-v1.png, card-pictures.json holds 31 rows, and the cited Monorepo lines are correct at HEAD 84e356bdf. The mapping table sums to 51 (card 15, patch 7, dots 10, Forge 19). The print card kit does not change, and the print modules read only entry.word, so the print output stays byte-equal. Forge pictures sit behind the H8 delivery check, and H11 routes a late folder to the PM. No Blocker found. One Major (this track's PROJECT_TESTS has no exclude for the loops track's red-by-design content file) and four Nits.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] plan.md Phase 10 gate block (PROJECT_TESTS) and Phase 10 verification task: this track's PROJECT_TESTS reads the glob __tests__/storytime-*.test.ts of the print and loops tracks, and it has no exclude for the loops track's red-by-design file storytime-loops-share-content.test.ts (loops rule R3 covers the print track and the loops track only). Rationale: the plan applies rule R1 to Red 1 and Red 2, but R1 governs the start of a Red window; Green 1, Green 2, the Forge delivery task, and the Phase 10 verification task can run while the loops Phase 3b R3 window is open, and at that time the package PROJECT_TESTS fails on a file of another track, so a phase gate can be red for a reason outside this phase and the plan records no exclude rule (the loops rule R2/R3 pattern) for this track.

F2 [Nit] spec.md H12 (the MANIFEST "Changed since" form): H12 cites the w01 r2 MANIFEST lines 51 to 63 as the form and states that a new file has old-sha256: none, but that folder writes an empty old-sha256: value for the new provenance file (line 68). Rationale: H12 is explicit, so the implementer builds none, while the cited record and the PM comparison show an empty value; the difference costs no work and only weakens the evidence line.

F3 [Nit] plan.md Phase 10 Package build task (Done when): the gate grep uses the literal path segment w0N, so the command prints 0 until the week number is put in its place. Rationale: a gate that needs a hand substitution is easy to run vacuously, and the intended loop over weeks 1 to 7 is clear from the family counts that follow.

F4 [Nit] spec.md H9 (the family-pictures check): H9 pins the id, the three statuses, and the detail strings, but it names no label for the check row. Rationale: every other row of check-weeks.ts carries a label, so the implementer picks the visible text and no test pins it.

F5 [Nit] spec.md H3 and H8 (the Forge source): H3 and H8 pin the Forge file name l2-w<NN>-card-<word>-v<k>.png and the MANIFEST line form, and no cited record fixes that name with the Forge side. Rationale: the PM request of 2026-11-07 names only the folder, so a different Forge name stops the script at H8 and costs a PM round trip under H11 (default: wait for Forge); Red and Green do not depend on the name.

paraphrase.proposes: Phase 10 gives one picture file to each of the 51 family words of Level 2 weeks 1 to 7: 15 words take the approved card pictures, 7 color words take the card-kit color patch, 10 number words take the numeral with dots, and 19 words take a new Forge picture. A new module builds the patch and number markup and a new script renders each picture to an 800 x 800 JPEG with a provenance file, and the script writes image.file into seven week files by the Phase 7 byte rules. A new check family-pictures reports a missing file, and one revision folder per week (w01 r3, w02 to w07 r2) goes to the PM by 2026-11-12 with a Changed since section, before Daniel sees the pictures in his 11-16 check. The print card kit does not change, and Forge pictures pass a delivery check before the first write.
paraphrase.current_system: The eight Level 2 week files under content/storytime/l2/ hold 51 family image objects with prompt, characters, and caption and no file, and week 8 holds 18 family words with no image object. The Storytime schema FamilyWordSchema accepts an optional image with a file, and the Monorepo receiver reads that file as a normal media item and otherwise reports a missing picture; the app shows a caption box when the file is absent. The teacher book and card sheets read only the family word text, so a family picture file does not change print output. The week media live under l2/media/w<nn>/ with a books provenance file per week, and the app package of each week is one folder under ~/Desktop/handoff/.
